errors.evidence: The description incorrectly translates "Solid fossil fuels" as "Всички изкопаеми горива" (All fossil fuels). This is inaccurate because Crude Oil and Natural Gas are also fossil fuels and are listed as separate categories in the chart. The correct translation would be "Твърди изкопаеми горива".
The description does not mention the vertical axis of the stacked bar chart, which represents percentage and ranges from 0% to 100%.

The description identifies the second chart as a bar chart but fails to mention its key structural characteristic, which is that it is a stacked bar chart where different renewable sources add up to 100% of the renewable energy total.
The description does not mention the legend for the stacked bar chart, which maps colors to the different types of renewable energy.
